msContents.summary: A paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya.

msItem.title: Itihāsasamuccaya
msItem.colophon:
śrī śāke || 1783 || nabho sitadale
|| 26|02 || ślokasaṃkhyā na tu graṃthasya ||

supportDesc.foliation: Devanāgarī numerals, top-left and bottom-right margin, verso.

lg.l:
kathayantaṃ hitārtthānāṃ prabhāvān a
dbhutām̐s tathā ||
lomaśaṃ dharmatatvajñaṃ paryyapṛcchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 1 ||

yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ
brahman bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgatam ||
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana || 2 ||

e
kataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ ||
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam || 3 ||

ida
m eva purā devās tulayā samatolayan ||
prāṇarakṣaṇam evāhur gauraveṇātiricyate || 4 ||

atraivodā
harantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam ||
indrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiver auśīnarasya ca || 5 ||

varttamāne mahā
yajñe jijñāsārtthaṃ śiviṃ nṛpa ||
indraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ || 6 ||

atha taṃ nṛ
patiṃ prāha kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt ||
śaraṇārtthaṃ mahīpālaṃ nililye bhayavihvalaḥ || 7 ||

tataḥ śanair u
pāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ ||
rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā || 8 ||

dha
rmātmānaṃ ca tvāṃ prāhur ekaṃ rājan mahīkṣitām ||
sa tvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ karma cikīrṣasi || 9 ||

bhavān_
kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinam ||
kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunājayan || 10 ||

nopakārāpa
re py evam upakāraparo janaḥ ||
apakāraparo pi tvam upakaraparo yathā || 11 ||

ahite hitabuddhis tvaṃ pāpe pi
tvam apāpakṛt ||
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣo pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ || 12 ||

tad ayaṃ vihito bhakṣyaḥ pīḍyamā
nasya me kṣudhā ||
mā hiṃsīr lobhato dharmmaṃ dharmmam utsṛṣṭavān asi || 13 ||

saṃtrastarūpas trā
ṇārtthī tvato bhīto vihaṅgamaḥ ||
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇagṛdhnur ayaṃ khagaḥ || 14 ||

tad evam āgatasyā
sya kapotasyābhayārtthinaḥ ||
katham asmadvidhāḥ kuryyus tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitam || 15 ||

lobhād dveṣād bhayā
d vāpi yas tyajec charaṇāgatam ||
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 16 ||

śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir dṛ
ṣṭā mahāpātakinām api ||
śaraṇāgatahantṝṇāṃ na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit || 17 ||

yathātmānaḥ priyāḥ
prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ||
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ || 18 ||

janmamṛtyuja
rāduḥkhair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare ||
jantavaḥ parikliśyante mṛtyos trasyanti te tathā || 19 ||

yannimittaṃ bhevec cho
kas trāso vā krodha eva ca ||
āyāso vā yato mūlam ekāham api saṃtyajet || 20 ||

mariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ
puruṣasyopajāyate ||
jñeyaṃ tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣitum || 21 ||

yathā hi te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ
tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyam ||
saṃrakṣatete jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitam || 22 ||
tasmān nāham amuṃ bhītam arpayiṣye kapotakam ||
yac cātra yuktaṃ sarvaṃ me karttuṃ śyenāśu tad vada || 23 ||

vrajanti
brahmasadanam iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalam || 24 ||

bhītābhayapradā
nasya kṣayam eva na vidyate ||
bhītāya me kapotāya yat phalaṃ tan na vidyate || 25 ||

dattam iṣṭaṃ tathā taptaṃ tīrttha
sevā śrutaṃ tathā ||
sarvāṇy abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 26 ||

catuḥsāgaraparyantāṃ yo dadyā
t pṛthivīm imām ||
abhayaṃ yas tu bhūtebhyas tayor abhayado dhikaḥ || 27 ||

api sarvaṃ tyajed rājyaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudu
styajam ||
na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyajed dīnaṃ kapotakam || 28 ||

janmanas tu śubhaṃ kiṃcit kenacid anyaja
nmani ||
bhavet trātābhayārttānām ārttināśāya dehinām || 29 ||

na cāhaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpunarbhava
m ||
prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanam || 30 ||
yathā ca nānṛtāṃ vācam aham evam udāhare ||

sa
tyena tena bhagavān prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ || 31 ||
āhārārtthaṃ samārambhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṅgama ||

tad yatheṣṭaṃ
tavāhāram anyam eva dadāmy aham || 32 ||
ya eva vihito smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣyaṃ kapotakaḥ ||
tam evotsṛjya nānyena cāhāreṇa prayojanam ||33 ||
āhārāt sarvabhūtāni sambhavanti prajeśvara ||

ā
hāreṇa vivarddhante tena jīvanti jantavaḥ || 34 ||
śakyate ca vinā py artthai rājan varttayituṃ ciram ||

śakyate
duṣkare py artthe cirarātreṇa jīvitum || 35 ||
artthair anyair vināhāraṃ jīvitaṃ kasyacid bhavet ||

na tv ahāravi
hīnena śakyaṃ varttayitum ciram || 36 ||
bhakṣyād vilopitasyāsya mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate ||

vihāya kāyaṃ yā
syanti panthānam apunarbhavam || 37 ||
mṛte ca mayi sarvaṃ me putradāraṃ mariṣyati ||

rakṣamāṇaḥ kapotaṃ tvaṃ ba
hūn prāṇān haniṣyati || 38 ||
dharmaṃ yo bādhate dharmmo na sa dharmmaḥ paraṃtapaḥ ||

avirodhī tu yo dharmmaḥ sa dha
rmmaḥ sadbhir ucyate || 39 ||
tasmād virodhe dharmmasya saṃcintya gurulāghavam ||

yato bhūyāṃs tato rājan ku
ru dharmmavinirṇayam || 40 ||
bahukalyāṇasaṃyuktaṃ bhāṣase vihagottama ||

suparṇapakṣirā
ṭ_ tvaṃ hi dharma eva na saṃśayaḥ || 41 ||
yathā hi dharmma saṃyuktaṃ bahucitraṃ prabhāṣase ||

na te hy aviditaṃ vi
ditaṃ kiṃcid iti tvāṃ lakṣayāmy aham || 42 ||
nāto bhūyaḥparo dharmmaḥ kaścid anyo sti khecara ||

prāṇi
nāṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate || 43 ||
varam ekasya satvasya datvā abhayadakṣiṇām ||

na tu viprasaha
srasya gosahasram alaṅkṛtam || 44 ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ ||

tasya dehād vimuktasya
na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || 45 ||
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi ||

durllabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtā
bhayāpradaḥ || 46 ||
śyenāḥ kapotān khādanti śrutir eṣā sanātanī ||

mā rājan sāram a
jñātvā kadalīstambham āruha || 47 ||
nāham ucchāstramārgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṅgama ||

śā
streṇaivopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmmaḥ satvadayāparaḥ || 48 ||
sarvasatveṣu yad dānam ekasatve ca yā dayā ||

sarvasa
tvapradānāt tu dayaikā ca viśiṣyate || 49 ||
sarvavedā na tat kuryyuḥ sarve yajñāś ca khecara ||

sarvatīrthā
bhiṣekaś ca yat kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā || 50 ||
vāṅmanaḥkarmabhir ye tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||

dayādarśita
panthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te || 51 ||
gacchatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā ||

yan na bhūtahi
tārtthāya tat paśor iva ceṣṭitam || 52 ||
jaṅgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ ||

ātmavat parirakṣa
nti te yānti paramāṃ gatim || 53 ||
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānaṃ tu yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣyate ||

sa yāti narakaṃ ghora
m iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 54 ||
rājyaṃ samastaṃ sumahat prayacchāmi taba dvija ||

yad vā kāmayase hy anyad va
rjayitvā kapotakam || 55 ||
yadi rājan kapotena sudṛḍhā bhaktir īdṛśī ||

tataḥ kapota
tulyāni svamāṃsāni prayaccha me || 56 ||
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase ||

etat te
haṃ prayacchāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad icchasi || 57 ||
yad apriyaṃ tat sujanaś cirād vadati vā na vā ||

mama tu priyam evai
tat kasmād abhihitaṃ cirāt || 58 ||
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā ||

dhruvaṃ yo nārjjayed dharmmaṃ
sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ || 59 ||
yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho 'yaṃ nopayujyate ||

tataḥ kim upacāro sya pratyahaṃ
kriyate vṛthā || 60 ||
nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce taba māṃsaṃ nareśvara ||

tasmāt kapotena samaṃ pra
yaccha tulayā dhṛtam || 61 ||
tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase ||

yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ
tan me tavāpi ca vihaṅgama || 62 ||
evam uktaḥ svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ ||

pra
hṛṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapotena saha prabhuḥ || 63 ||
tyaktvātmasukhabhogecchāṃ sarvasatvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ ||

bhava
nti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ || 64 ||
dhriyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyatiricyate ||

tataś cotkṛ
tya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ || 65 ||
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit ||

tataḥ prakṣiṇa
māṃso sau cāruroha tulāṃ svayam || 66 ||
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||

nopekṣante mahātmānaḥ
svasukhāni mahānty api || 67 ||
atha tasmin samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpe ||

devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpa
vṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca || 68 ||
tatas tasya tadā matvā dharme rājño dhṛtiṃ parām ||

śākraḥ svapurarūpam āsthāya vākyam eta
d abhāṣata || 69 ||
indro ham asmi bhadran te kapoto havyavāḍ ayam ||

jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rāja
nn imaṃ yajñam upāgatau || 70 ||
naitat sarve nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyanti cāpare ||

mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛ
taṃ duṣkṛtaṃ tvayā || 71 ||
parārtthe tyajataḥ prāṇān yā prītir abhavat tava ||
prāṇasaṃśayalubdheṣu na sā prāṇiṣu dehinām || 72 ||
parārtthaikāntakalyāṇī svāśreyātyantaniṣṭhurā ||

tvayy eva kevalaṃ rājan karuṇā ta
ruṇāyate || 73 ||
svakarmapāśaiḥ sudṛḍhair baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat ||

tvaṃ jagadduḥkhamokṣārtthaṃ baddhaḥ karu
ṇāyā nṛpa || 74 ||
tasmāt sarvātmanā vapi doṣeṣv apahṛtaṃ tvayā ||

yathā caivātmanaḥ sthāne vāsanāpi
na vidyate || 75 ||
akṛtverṣyāṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān anavamanya ca ||

akṛtvā sadṛśaiḥ sparddhāṃ tvaṃ loko
ttamatāṃ gataḥ || 76 ||
paropakārajanmāno vidhinā vihitās trayaḥ ||

sajalā jaladāḥ khe ca saphalā
ś ca mahādrumāḥ || 77 ||
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān yo naraḥ parirakṣati ||

sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma yato nāvarta
te punaḥ || 78 ||
prāṇair api tvayā rājan rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ khagaḥ ||

svamāṃsāny ca dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā ka
thā || 79 ||
paśavo pi hi jīvanti kevalātmodarambharāḥ ||
sa punar jīvitaḥ ślāghyo yaḥ parārtthe sa jīvati || 80 ||
kim atra citraṃ yat santaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ ||
na hi svadehaśītāya jāyante candanadrumāḥ || 81 ||

paropakā
ravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā ||
saṃpadaṃ tad avāpnoti parād api hi yat paradam || 82 ||

paropakāraikadhiyaḥ
svasukhāya gataspṛhāḥ ||
jagaddhitāya jāyante sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi || 83 ||

yat svamāṃsāni gātre
bhyaḥ samutkṛttāni pārthivaḥ ||
eṣā te śāśvatī kīrttir lokān anugāmiṣyati || 84 ||

divyarūpadharaś cai
va pālayitvā mahiṃ ciram ||
sarvalokān atikramya brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi || 85 ||
evam uktvā tu indrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayam ||
rājā ca kratum iṣṭvā ca mumude devavac ciram || 86 ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śiveś caritam uttamam ||
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivaṃ naraḥ || 87 ||

vici
ntya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśaḥ sarvajanasya durllabham ||

śarīradānāt paradānarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya
lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau || 88 ||

body.p: itihāsasamuccaye śiveś caritaṃ nāma caturttho dhyāyaḥ || 4 || 369 ||
